fields.climate: varies from tropical along coast to arid in interior
fields.terrain: low plains rise to central highlands bisected by Great Rift Valley; fertile plateau in west
fields.hazards: recurring drought; flooding during rainy seasons; volcanism: limited volcanic activity; the Barrier (1,032 m) last erupted in 1921; South Island is the only other historically active volcano
fields.resources: limestone, soda ash, salt, gemstones, fluorspar, zinc, diatomite, gypsum, wildlife, hydropower
fields.farm: sugarcane, milk, maize, bananas, tea, potatoes, cassava, cabbages, camel milk, mangoes/guavas
fields.exports: tea, cut flowers, garments, gold, tropical fruits
fields.industries: agriculture, transportation, services, manufacturing, construction, telecommunications, tourism, retail
fields.religions: Christian 85.5% (Protestant 33.4%, Catholic 20.6%, Evangelical 20.4%, African Instituted Churches 7%, other Christian 4.1%), Muslim 10.9%, other 1.8%, none 1.6%, don't know/no answer 0.2%
fields.legal: mixed system of English common law, Islamic law, and customary law; Supreme Court reviews laws
